st: Angry Planet - Arctic Winter
d: George links up with two experienced polar adventurers to explore the frigid Canadian arctic in the depths of winter. The team first uses skis to cross the fractured sea ice of Frobisher Bay, then dog teams to head north through the spectacular Auyuittuq Mountains.

st: Angry Planet - Highway to Hail
d: George and three side-kicks head straight into the “Bearcage”, looking to get beat up by the biggest, baddest hailstones that Texas and Oklahoma can throw at them. They find it – and their stormchasing vehicles don’t look too pretty after coming through these massive storms.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Meet Island Air
d: Alaskan bush pilots risk everything to save hunters struggling to stay alive in a remote area of Kodiak.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Without a Trace
d: Tanalian Aviation pilots assist with a search and rescue for an experienced hiker in the winter wilderness.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Fight or Flight
d: While on a routine sightseeing flight, a massive storm has the pilots fighting to keep their passengers safe.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Heaven at 5,000 Feet
d: Pilot Josiah Freeman takes a professional snowboarder Mark Barajas to the top of the Chugach Mountains for some hellacious heli-skiing.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Deadman's Survival
d: Island Air battles time and the elements, to rescue a group trapped in Deadman's Bay.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Into The Deep
d: The bush pilots have to use all their skills - scuba diving, underwater rigging and expert flying - to try and salvage a de Havilland Beaver wing at the bottom of the 6 Mile Lake.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Desperate Times
d: Island Air drops off a group of desperate hunters in the heart of the bush as a deep freeze hits Kodiak.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - On Thin Ice
d: On a rare day off, Josiah and his friends white water raft where few have gone before - on top of the massive Knik Glacier.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Risky Business
d: Pilot Peter Rosendahl combats gail force wind while taxiing a group of hunters to a floating lodge.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Ice Climbers
d: Tanalian Aviation battles winter weather to ferry ice climbers onto the Knik Glacier.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Training Day
d: New pilots are put to the test to see if they have what it takes to fly for Island Air.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Salvage Gone Awry
d: Joel and Mark Barker tempt fate and fly into no man's land to find and salvage a white airplane in a snowy forest, and fight hypothermia along the way.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Surf's Up
d: Rough seas have a couple of surfers turning to Island Air for an adventure of a life time.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Hanging by a Thread
d: Tanalian Aviation bush pilots Joel and Josiah earn their keep slinging a stranded snow machine.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Closing Time
d: An unexpected storm leaves Island Air struggling to pull their planes for mandatory maintenance.

st: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - Flying High
d: The Tanalian bush pilots transport extreme paragliders to Moose Creek, in the Talkeetna Range, for a once-in-a-lifetime airborne experience.

st: Extreme Weather Countdown - The Flashflood Gates Are Open!
d: Weather has always been here, from long before arrived, and it will stick around long after we are gone. This unstoppable force has both enhanced and ruined people's days since the dawn of time...but it also creates some incredible situations. Lucky for you, we've captured some of the best for you to see. Strap in and prepare yourself, because it's time once again for Extreme Weather Countdown.

st: Extreme Weather Countdown - Rain Check
d: Here at Extreme Weather Countdown, no natural phenomenon is too crazy, and we've returned with an episode chock-full of footage from the eye of the storm. Settle in, because there are rough seas ahead.

d: Today's countdown will give you a front row seat to weather phenomena from around the globe!

d: Are you ready to have dust devils, tornadoes, floods, and thunderstorms flashing before your eyes? You'd better be, because you're watching Extreme Weather Countdown, where we waste no time filling your screen with the most intense weather events caught on camera.
